narration: This is the FactoryLM Command Board — the single live view of your maintenance operation, with every open item front and center.
At the top, the L5 Proposal flywheel tracks your namespace readiness — assets indexed, documents reviewed, verified edges — guiding you to verify knowledge until MIRA can cite it.
Four live counters summarize the day: open work orders, overdue PMs, total work orders, and the preventive maintenance MIRA auto-extracted from your manuals.
Below, every open issue streams in as a card — here, four work orders on the Stardust Racers, each with its priority, age, and one tap to open it or ask MIRA.
One board. Every pending decision. Always live.
